name: Tools of the trade
detailed_description:
Grab your tools and embark on a cozy adventure across a whimsical medieval world where crafting, teamwork, and resource management collide! Tools of the Trade offers an endearing mix of exploration and creativity — perfect for solo adventurers and couch co-op enthusiasts alike.

  • Solo-friendly and couch-co-op drop-in/out (1–4 players)

  • Two-hands item system for instant, tactile crafting

  • Branching caravan map with quest-filled towns

  • Ever-growing recipe book and upgradeable wagon-workshop

  • Wholesome humor, zero high-stress timers

Crafting Together… or Alone

Create anything from handy camp tools to grand community projects with an intuitive two-hands system. Whether you venture solo or team up with friends who can drop in and out at any moment, there’s always a task waiting for you.

A Cozy, Light-hearted Vibe

There are no looming disasters here — only the satisfying hunt for one more bundle of logs. Explore a whimsical world where creativity thrives, surprises pop up around every corner, and the occasional comedic mishap keeps you smiling. With no doom-and-gloom timer breathing down your neck, you’re free to strategize, wander, and craft at your own pace — embracing relaxed fun over high-stress intensity.

Fluid Roles in Multiplayer

Swap duties on the fly — fell a tree, fire up the forge, or hammer together the final pieces — whatever the moment demands. Because jobs aren’t locked in, each quest turns into a lively shuffle of teamwork (and the occasional bit of friendly chaos) between you and your friends.

Whimsical Medieval Aesthetic

Stroll through hamlets and bustling market squares, each steeped in its own quirky charm. As you complete quests, spruce up your humble wagon until it transforms into a roving workshop worthy of the kingdom’s finest crafters.

Ready your hammer and hop aboard — your Tools of the Trade adventure begins soon!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit +
  • Processor: Intel Core i3/Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan support required
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1-4 Controllers for multiplayer
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit +
  • Processor: Intel Core i5/Ryzen 5 or above
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan support required
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1-4 Controllers for multiplayer
